metadata.name: Multi-Run Timer
metadata.description:
This mod tracks the total amount of time that passes while in-game, skipping the time that passes when in the main menu. The idea is to automatically track the time for long speedrun categories (such as Dead God%).
To see the timer, enter the "Multi-Run Timer" custom challenge.
See the source code for this mod on GitHub: https://github.com/Zamiell/isaac-multi-run-timer/
